title: Market regime classification
summary: Label each period trending or ranging, and high or low volatility, with a written rule. The same method behaves differently in each regime.
unreliableWhen: The label uses past candles, so it lags, and regimes change without warning. The thresholds are your choice; changing them moves periods between labels.
goodExample: Splitting backtest results by regime and finding a crossover rule did well only in trends and lost small amounts in ranges.
badExample: Leaving the losing ranging periods out of a test because "the rule is not meant for those".

chart.lookFor: Measure the net move over the last 20 candles in ATR terms and give the chart a label. Count how often price crossed the SMA 20. Then compare with Strong uptrend and High volatility.
